notes.title: Update progress
notes.content:
Update progress is at full speed, Here is where I want to outline some progress we have made so far, We Also expect this HUGE update to come out in the next few months, So all the things below are NOT yet live.

Fixed for Zombie spawning (Sometimes they would get stuck or). 
Fixed Zombies spawning time(There was a chance the zombie timer would get stuck at 1 meaning the zombies would stop spawning). 
Fixed reloading when sprinting. 
Disabled VR Plugin for now (i plan to bring VR later down the line now I have a VR). 
Fixed a small chance the HUD would get stuck when loading into a game.
Fixed “RevivingPlayer” text stuck on screen 
Fixed an issue with players getting stuck on spectate screen Fixed a small chance that players would spawn in seeing other people progress
           
Added 8 different player-able characters all with strengths and weaknesses (You pick how you play, Want to have more health but less movement speed).

Added in a new XP and Quest system (Quest may or may not be fully in when the update is live, If it is now we have all the code there ready to add more later). 

Our map dev is working on 3 new maps for the game. 

Updated some Hud elements to make it feel cleaner.

Made it so players can act as soul boxes (with limits).
 
Added in new guns

Added Melee weapons into the game.

DLSS Will be set with each map you play. This will be automictic and be set as balanced, This will only affect people will GPUs that support it and that is checked automictically (We do plan to have this as a graphic menu option)

Added the settings menu when you pause the game Before you had to leave the game fully, Now you don't.


We have more coming in the next few months and we thank you all for sticking with us, We are also committed to the goals we outlined in our early access statements

Achievements system is now in-game. Not steam Achievements as the Achievements  system I have in-game can be carried from one platform to another

I have started on the next map for the game.

and a lot more.

notes.title: Soul box Update
notes.content:
Hey all. So I want to outline what this update brings.

Soul Box is now in the game. kill zombies in the range of the soul box and once you have killed X amount a door will open to guns or power-ups

Updated a few guns to feel more powerful

Minor bug fixes.

Made a how to start video for the game [previewyoutube=qZLJs1iWIi8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










What I am working on

I am working on achievements.

I plan in the next month to add a new map and 3 new guns.

Also working on the MP side to make it more stable.


I want to talk to all of you for supporting us and we are not stopping now. I cant wait to see how the game goes and updates

notes.title: Here is our first major update for the game
notes.content:
Here is our first major update for the game, let me outline what has changed.

This update should fix the following

Zombie Spawning or lack of

FPS drops in MP for high rounds.

Clipping of zombies.

Adds new guns.

and I have remade the maps.

Size on disk is from 10gb to 2.3gb

I have spent the time to basically remake the core of the game.

Please let us know any bugs or problems you have

notes.title: Huge Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Morning/Afternoon/Evening all.

I Have some amazing new I want to share with you all.

Since the game release, you guys have found a lot of bugs we missed in our playtests.

Hence why I have been spending the time to update and fix a lot of the bugs and add in a lot of content.

Bugs that will be fixed next update.

Zombies not spawning and/or getting stuck/ clipping issues

Zombies stopping spawning after higher rounds

Sounds issues.

What will be added in the next update

4 new maps. this will be a remake of the maps you have now. Day/Dusk/Night/crazy dark

5 new guns including a grenade launcher.

Music in the background of all rounds, all music is safe for twitch and youtube

Things removed in the next update.

For now First-person this is so I can fix and make it better BUT it will be back

The maps you have now for new ones.


I want to thank you all for playing our game and I have some huge plans for the future.

Mythic Gaming Team
